column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “along with.”
“Go among them” is rendered “associate with them,” and “cleaved … to love” as “held fast to these in love.”
“Astarte the god” is rendered “Ashtoreth the goddess,” and “detestable thing” as “detestable idol.”
“Did not fill after the LORD” is rendered “did not follow the LORD fully.”
“On the face of Jerusalem” is rendered “east of Jerusalem,” and “detestable thing” as “detestable idol.”
“It has been this with you” is rendered “you have done this.”
“The offspring of the king” is rendered “the royal line.”
The Hebrew “when David was with Edom” is rendered “was in Edom”; some ancient versions read “struck Edom.”
NASB puts the verse in parentheses.
“Gave him a wife” is rendered “gave him in marriage.”
NASB supplies “that Hadad did”; the Hebrew is elliptical.
“An Ephrathite” is rendered “an Ephraimite,” and “raised a hand” as “rebelled.”
“A mighty man of strength” is rendered “a valiant warrior,” and “doing work” as “industrious.”
NASB supplies “Ahijah” as the one wearing the cloak.
